description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the SuiteCRM utility Paths class, testing methods that return various project directory paths.

classes.name: PathsTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case for testing SuiteCRM\Utility\Paths methods.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creates Paths instance if not already created, and sets project path.

methods.name: testGetProjectPath
methods.description: Verifies that getProjectPath returns the expected project path.

methods.name: testGetLibraryPath
methods.description: Verifies that getLibraryPath returns the expected library directory path.

methods.name: testGetContainersPath
methods.description: Verifies that getContainersFilePath returns the expected containers.php file path.
